title: New Project CAV3RN .NET Native AOT communication module
content: Kaspersky identified a new .NET Native AOT communication module for Project CAV3RN, a sophisticated cyberespionage framework targeting Israel. This module replaces the previous HTTP/WebSocket component by exchanging commands through Outlook calendar events accessed via Microsoft Graph API.
